Arbaal unleashes his fury and slaughters his foes with reckless abandon. He gains a surge of energy and can move again on the campaign map. However, this also drains some of his bloodlust and reduces his favor with Khorne.
Shackle them to the quarries and the ramparts. The Watch Towers of the north were raised upon thrall-bones, and thrall-bones shall keep them standing.
Drive the hardiest of the chattel into the baggage trains and siege lines, so that every true Druchii blade is free for the slaughter.
By the Keeper's leave, the choicest stock of the northern pens goes beneath the hammer. Highborn from every city bid for the privilege, and pay dearly for it.
